description: This file defines React components for rendering runtime error overlays, including call stack frames and error details, in a Next.js development environment.

classes.name: CallStackFrame
classes.description: React functional component for rendering individual call stack frames with optional source link.

classes.name: RuntimeError
classes.description: React functional component for rendering a detailed runtime error overlay, including source code and call stack.

methods.name: CallStackFrame
methods.description: Component to display a single call stack frame with optional link to open in editor.

methods.name: RuntimeError
methods.description: Main component to display runtime error details, source code, and call stack with toggle options.
